Deep jewel tones dominate the palette, creating a dense lattice grid structure across the surface. The central field is filled with repeating, stylized floral motifs, all contained within a structured design. The composition is given weight by a prominent border along the bottom edge, which is comprised of a rhythmic sequence of alternating large squares and smaller diamond shapes. The piece is purely decorative and remains completely still.

The composition features a repeating grid structure filled with stylized floral motifs at regular intervals, all contained within a structured framework. A prominent border along the bottom edge displays a rhythmic sequence of alternating large squares and diamond shapes, reinforcing the architectural quality of the pattern. The work is purely decorative and remains completely still, embodying the rich, detailed aesthetic of traditional Persian carpet weaving through digital means.
